listings.name: Ace Hardware Stetson Hills
listings.hours_source: store hours on the Ace Colorado Springs Stetson Hills location page
listings.propane_hours_note: Group propane page and store page advertise full-service propane filling during store hours. No separate propane window posted — ask at the desk; fill can stop when the trained associate is unavailable.
listings.notes: Owner group site acecoloradosprings.com/propane/ says they refill 5–100 lb tanks at their locations; store page lists Full Service Propane Filling. Free inspections stated; tanks older than 12 years must be requalified before refill — that is a refill rule, not a claim that Ace itself recertifies. No clear exchange claim on the propane page — labeled fill only. Call for price.
